title: Autodeploy: scoped Cloudflare token for the deploy workflow
description: deploy.yml deploys the aeryx Worker on every push to main but needs secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (account token scoped to Workers Scripts Write and Account Settings Read, nothing else) and repo variable CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Until both exist the deploy step fails and deploys are manual (npx wrangler deploy).
close_reason: Website deploys stay manual (npx wrangler deploy); no CI deploy.
